newsitem.title: USA: Able says revision to cut EPS.
newsitem.headline: Able says revision to cut EPS.

text.p: Able Telcom Holding Corp said Friday that earnings for the first three quarters of fiscal 1997 will be cut by an accounting change, but it expects its operating results to remain in line with analysts' expectations.

The company said it will revise its accounting for the discounted conversion on the convertible preferred stock it issued on December 20, 1996, effective with the first quarter ended January 31, 1997.

The company said the revision, for purposes of calculating earnings per share only, will result in nonrecurring reductions of earnings per share of $0.02, $0.05 and $0.01 in the first, second and third quarters of fiscal year 1997, respectively.
The company said the revision will not impact net income or cash flow.
